episodes.title: The Confession
episodes.summary: Hazel receives a strange birthday card that ultimately forces her mother, Melissa, to face the dark truth of her past.

episodes.title: Killing Shame
episodes.summary: Melissa and Ivy travel to Texas to learn everything about Heather Richmond's murder; their discovery there pushes Melissa to step into the light.

episodes.title: Was It Worth It?
episodes.summary: Melissa navigates the highs and lows of going public with her story; the team questions Elijah's innocence as Keith gets thrown into solitary.

episodes.title: Controlled Burn
episodes.summary: Melissa reconnects with her brother and confronts her father, who finally offers a clue about the case; Hazel receives an unexpected invitation.

episodes.title: Don't Dream
episodes.summary: Melissa forms an unlikely alliance to recover missing key evidence; Elijah weighs a plea deal; Hazel begins a secret correspondence.

episodes.title: Lorelai
episodes.summary: Melissa and Ivy find unknown footage of Heather that changes everything; Elijah has his day in court; Ben gets bad news at work and worse news at home; Joyce's secret is revealed.

episodes.title: My Jesperson Girls
episodes.summary: Melissa faces a dark family secret that leads her back to Ash.

episodes.title: The Star
episodes.summary: Melissa solves the case; Keith suffers an attack; Ben faces consequences for his actions.
